208:
[Partial translation]
On the seventh of the Holiday [Sukkot], it is the end of the [yearly] judgment of the world, and messages come out from the house of the King. So the restrictive powers [gevurot] are aroused and end on that day, and the willows of the brook are with (another version: depend upon) them. And we need to arouse the restrictive powers for water and to go around seven times, to sate the altar with the water of Issac, since this well of Issac's is filled with water. And when it is full, the whole world is blessed with water.
210:
[Partial translation]
And there is the mark of Shad"ai, that is Metatro"n as servant, and many servants are dependent on him, that he is the appointed one on those who are servants in order to receive a reward (see Avot 1:3). Metatro"n and his servants are appointed over them. And regarding them it is said: "so that your ox and your donkey and your slave and your female slave rest" (Exodus 23:12). But those who observe/follow/serve the commandments without the intention of receiving a reward, those are the children of the King and the Matronita. And they are the crowns and the adornments on the head, that serve on the common days. And regarding them it is said "and those who make use of the crown disappear" (Avot 1:13) and "the stranger that comes" on them "will die" since the Shabatot are called for the servants.
212:
[Partial translation]
Rabbi Abba said: Wine, oil, and water came from the same place. Water and oil are on the right. The priests took them and inherited them. But oil is better than all. As it is joy [at] the beginning and at the end, as it is written: It is like fine oil on the head, running down onto the beard, the beard of Aaron (Psalms 133:2). And wine is on the left. The Levites inherited it for the raising of the voice and for song, but not to be silent. As wine is never for silence, but oil is always discreet.

What is the difference between this and that? It is only that oil, which is discreet, is always whispered; it comes from the place of thought, which is always whispering and is never heard. And that is discreet, and that is why it is on the right. But wine, which is for the raising of the voice and is never silent, comes from the side of the Mother [Ima]. And the Levites inherit it from the left side, and it acts for song and for the raising of the voice, and it acts for judgment. And that is why it is written: and by their word shall every controversy and every blemish be [decided] (Deuteronomy 21:5).

Because of this, when a priest goes up to the Temple to do the service, it is forbidden for him to drink wine. As they serve with discretion, and they discreetly come and concentrate, and they pair the one that needs to be paired and bring down blessings to all of the world. But it is all discreet, and they do all of these [things] in secret. Whereas wine reveals secrets, as all of its works act for the raising of the voice.
213: Whether with beasts, with [wild] animals, with fowl or with fish of the sea, there is right and left (mercy and strict judgement) seen in them. And it is permitted for us to eat from anyone who comes from the side of the right (from the side of mercy). But it is forbidden for us to eat from anyone who comes from the side of the left (from the side of strict justice). This is on account of the level (other books, that the essence) of all of them being impure; so that they all are impure and a spirit of impurity rests upon them and dwells within them. And therefore the holy spirit of the Jewish people cannot mix with them, so that it not become impure from them. For holiness should be found within them, so they can be known above and below. Fortunate is the portion of the Jewish people, for the holy King desires them and wants to purify them and to sanctify them over everything, because they cling to Him.
